site.audience: cryptocurrency investors, traders, and enthusiasts seeking real-time market data

brief.title: CoinTracker Pro — Cryptocurrency Prices, Charts and Market Capitalizations
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive cryptocurrency market data dashboard showing live prices, market caps, and trading volumes for thousands of digital assets.
brief.goal: Provide users with an at-a-glance overview of the entire cryptocurrency market, including sortable rankings, price changes, and key market indicators to support informed trading decisions.

pages.objective: Display a ranked table of the top 100 cryptocurrencies by market cap with key metrics, market indicators, and filtering options.

interactions.trigger: Click on Top, Trending, Watchlist, Prediction Markets, Most Visited, or New tabs
interactions.expected: The cryptocurrency table filters to show the selected category of assets

interactions.trigger: Click on network filter tabs (All Networks, BSC, Solana, Base, Ethereum, More)
interactions.expected: The table filters to show only cryptocurrencies on the selected blockchain network

interactions.trigger: Click the Columns button above the table
interactions.expected: A dropdown or panel appears allowing users to toggle which columns are visible in the table

interactions.trigger: Click the Filters button above the table
interactions.expected: A filter panel expands allowing users to set criteria for filtering the cryptocurrency list

interactions.trigger: Promotional banner auto-rotates or user swipes/clicks arrows
interactions.expected: The promotional banner slides to show different announcements or promotions

interactions.trigger: Click page numbers (1, 2, 3, 4... 84) at the bottom of the table
interactions.expected: The table loads the next set of 100 cryptocurrencies

interactions.trigger: Click Read More in the market summary section
interactions.expected: The market summary text expands to show additional market data details

data_display.description: Top bar showing global market cap, CMC20 index value, Fear & Greed index score with label, and Altcoin Season index
A 100-row table of cryptocurrencies ranked by market cap, showing columns: Rank, Name, Price, 1h%, 24h%, 7d%, Market Cap, Volume(24h), Circulating Supply, and a 7-day sparkline chart
Summary paragraph showing global crypto market cap, 24h volume, DeFi volume share, stablecoin volume, and Bitcoin dominance percentage
CoinTracker 20 Index row at the top of the table showing index price and percentage changes
